name: Mailflare
description: Inboxes, transactional email, contacts, campaigns and automations on your own Cloudflare account.

required.why: Deploy the app's Workers, Durable Objects, Workflows and Queues
Store contacts, campaigns, templates and the delivery ledger
Store raw messages, attachments, uploads and exports
Receive mail for your domains in your inboxes

optional.why: Write SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for you

secrets.name: DEFAULT_FROM
secrets.ask: Sender used when a send names none, e.g. "Acme <hello@acme.com>"

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.ask: Password for an SMTP mailbox used only as a fallback when Email Service is unavailable

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.ask: Your Cloudflare account ID, so the Overview can show your daily sending quota and reputation

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL_READ_TOKEN
secrets.ask: A read-only API token with Email Sending: Read, for the quota and reputation on the Overview

cost.typicalMonthlyUsd: $5 plan; 3,000 emails a month included, then $0.35 per 1,000 (Email Service pricing, 2026-10-16)
